scope: Human-worn, wearer-perspective recordings. Room cameras, spectators, and robot-mounted cameras do not satisfy the core benchmark requirement.

sources.name: EGOFALLS
sources.attribution: Wang, Xueyi, EGOFALLS: A visual-audio dataset and benchmark for fall detection using egocentric cameras, DataverseNL, doi:10.34894/HO5GE3, version 1.1.
sources.license: CC0-1.0, verified in original Dataverse metadata
sources.camera_mount: Human-worn neck and waist; local subset uses publisher-labeled Neck directories only
sources.acquisition_status: 36 original clips downloaded by exact HTTP byte range; publisher ZIP CRC32 and local SHA-256 verified
sources.eligible_use: First-person visual fall versus nonfall screening, with body-to-head domain gap explicitly retained
limitations: Not head-mounted glasses footage
Staged activity labels do not establish medical collapse, injury, or need for help
Dataset metadata and repository counts differ; local counts come from inspected archives
Candidate duplicate files exist across Neck and Waist directories
Local sample is small; source Indoor folders include outdoor-looking footage, so matched environments are unverified
Source labels await independent human adjudication

sources.name: WEAR
sources.camera_mount: Human-worn head strap, tilted downward 45 degrees
sources.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, stated on original project page
sources.eligible_use: Potential hard negatives after confirming noncommercial research scope
limitations: No emergency-positive classes
Exercise context differs from everyday glasses use
Noncommercial restriction; do not treat the code license as the media license

sources.name: Ego4D / Ego-Exo4D
sources.camera_mount: Wearable first-person cameras; select ego streams and verify mount per recording
sources.license: Custom dataset agreement; access now through Lab22
sources.acquisition_status: Access-gated; no media or annotations downloaded
sources.eligible_use: Potential long-duration everyday negatives after agreement and clip-level event review
limitations: Requires license acceptance and credentials
An everyday activity label does not guarantee absence of hazards
Do not use exocentric streams from paired ego/exo recordings

sources.name: VIEW360
sources.license: No usable public media license verified
sources.acquisition_status: Original project still says Data (Coming Soon); no usable release downloaded
sources.eligible_use: Candidate for wearer-directed threat research once released and licensed
limitations: 360-degree views include events behind the wearer that forward-facing glasses cannot see
Not a verified assault/medical-collapse benchmark
Threat labels require visibility and wearer-role review; never infer criminal intent from appearance

sources.name: NUS First Person Interaction Dataset
sources.license: No explicit media license verified on author dataset page
sources.eligible_use: Potential wearer-directed interaction confounders after rights and perspective review
limitations: Includes actions passively observed by the wearer; retain only active-participant classes
Throwing an object is not itself proof of an assault or emergency

sources.name: EgoPolice
sources.license: Raw media has source restrictions; repository code license does not grant raw-video rights
sources.eligible_use: Not included in core wearer-victim benchmark
limitations: Wearer is often an officer intervening in another person's situation
Must annotate whether danger concerns the camera wearer
Public availability and original release policies can change

excluded_sources.name: AIRTLab, GMDCSA24, CAUCAFall, URFD, RWF-2000, XD-Violence
excluded_sources.reason: Room/surveillance/spectator views do not meet the user's wearer-perspective requirement. No media included.

excluded_sources.name: JPL First-Person Interaction / UTKinect-FirstPerson humanoid
excluded_sources.reason: Camera on a humanoid stand-in, not the person experiencing the situation. Excluded even though it is camera-centric.

excluded_sources.name: Generated images, first-person gameplay, and event descriptions
excluded_sources.reason: Cannot substitute for real human-worn recordings in a readiness evaluation.

unfilled_coverage: Long untrimmed glasses recordings of ordinary life
Low light and outdoor negatives matched to positive environments
